update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.61 - Fix duplicate support card equip, fix legacy picker loop, add race-bonus borrow sort mode
Fixes ----- - Auto support card equip no longer picks the same owned card for two deck slots. - Owned-support/borrow steps no longer tap into the legacy parent picker that was left open from a prior step.
New --- - Friend borrow priority can now be sorted by "Race bonus" (each card's in-kit race bonus stat) instead of overall goal fit, via a new setting in Parent Farming.
